screens.observed: Resting heart rate detail; main chart, daily/weekly/monthly/yearly controls, Score Contribution 98 and Contributor Details with Average last 7 days and Community Average. Those bottom numbers belong to the score section, not raw bpm.
Sleep detail; Heart Rate card with Lowest Heart Rate 44 BPM, Average 53 BPM and a marked Lowest HR Zone on the overnight line chart.
Dynamic Recovery Score screen; Add a tag action and contributor rows including resting heart rate with a range status.

proposals: Compact comparison of selected-day resting pulse with personal history, expressed in bpm. A longer personal baseline requires additional measurements beyond the current demo week.
Small event-tag row connected to the selected day and assistant context. Manual events or connected device data would be separate implementation work.
Short on-demand explanation through the info control rather than a permanent long article.
decision: User requested populated demo data and less text. Personal range and comparison now form one compact unframed section. Three measurements are visible by default; education moved to a header info popover. No event tags or statistics bento.
